title: UGC NET applicants to challenge answer key, candidates required to pay Rs 200 per challenged response
summary: The UGC NET applicants will be given a chance to challenge the answer key. The candidates will have to pay an amount of Rs 200 per answer key challenged. The CSIR NET Answer Key 2026 was released on June 15, and now applicants can download the provisional answer key and response sheet from the official website.
summary_points: UGC NET applicants allowed to challenge answer key
Candidates required to pay Rs 200 per challenged response
CSIR NET Answer Key 2026 released on June 15
Provisional answer key and response sheet available for download
Applicants can challenge answer key from the official website
